# Sylven OS

> Sylven OS is a global, community-driven open-source organization where developers learn, build real-world software, and teach others through collaborative engineering. The community's motto is "Learn. Build. Educate."

Sylven OS runs entirely in the open on GitHub. It is free to join, requires no application or membership fee, and welcomes contributors regardless of prior open-source experience. Projects are tagged with difficulty and status labels (Beginner / Intermediate / Advanced, Active / Planning / Completed / Beta / Archived) so new contributors can find an appropriate starting point. The community is fully remote and globally distributed; contributors collaborate asynchronously through GitHub and Discord.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://sylvenos.com/): Mission overview, community values, and how the ecosystem works.
- [About](https://sylvenos.com/about): The organization's story, mission, vision, philosophy, and who can join.
- [Projects](https://sylvenos.com/projects): Live registry of open-source repositories maintained by the organization, pulled directly from GitHub, with tech stack, difficulty, and contribution status for each. Each project has its own detail page at /projects/{slug}.
- [Contributors](https://sylvenos.com/contributors): Community overview, live contributor rankings, the core team, contribution philosophy, and recognition program.
- [Contact](https://sylvenos.com/contact): Every channel for reaching the team (email, Discord, GitHub, social).
- [Privacy Policy](https://sylvenos.com/privacy): What data the site does and does not collect.
- [Terms of Service](https://sylvenos.com/terms): Terms for using the site and participating in the community.

## Organization facts

- Name: Sylven OS (also written SylvenOS)
- Type: Open-source developer community / GitHub organization
- Motto: Learn. Build. Educate.
- Cost to join: Free — no membership fee, application, or paywall
- Format: Fully remote, globally distributed, async-first
- GitHub: https://github.com/sylvenos
- X / Twitter: https://x.com/sylvenos_
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/company/sylvenos

- Primary tech stack across projects: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Node.js, Tailwind CSS
- This website's own source: https://github.com/SylvenOS/SylvenOS-Web (MIT licensed)

## How to contribute (in order)

1. Join — Join the Discord and introduce yourself with your core tech stack interest.
2. Explore Projects — Browse the live project registry at /projects and pick a repository that fits your interests.
3. Read Documentation — Review the project's architecture specs and local setup instructions.
4. Pick an Issue — Claim an unassigned issue, ideally one labeled "Beginner" or "Good First Issue" if you're new.
5. Contribute — Write and test your code, then push your branch.
6. Review — Open a pull request and go through maintainer code review.
7. Merge — Once tests pass and review is approved, your change is merged and deployed.
8. Become a Maintainer — Sustained, high-quality contributions can lead to a maintainer role: reviewing code, managing features, and mentoring new contributors.

Contribution isn't limited to code — documentation, UI/UX design, testing, translation, community support, and content creation all count.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is Sylven OS?
A: Sylven OS is a global, community-driven open-source organization where developers learn, build real-world software, and teach others through collaborative engineering.

Q: Is Sylven OS free to join?
A: Yes, completely free, with no membership fee or application process.

Q: Can beginners contribute?
A: Yes. Sylven OS explicitly labels beginner-friendly issues and requires no prior open-source experience.

Q: What tech stack does Sylven OS use?
A: Commonly TypeScript, Next.js, React, Node.js, and Tailwind CSS, though it varies per project — each project page lists its exact stack live from GitHub.

Q: Can I contribute without writing code?
A: Yes — documentation, design, testing, translation, community support, and content are all recognized contributions.

Q: Is Sylven OS remote?
A: Yes, fully remote and globally distributed, with async collaboration via GitHub and Discord.

Q: How do I become a maintainer?
A: Through sustained, high-quality contributions over time; active contributors are invited into maintainer/leadership roles.

Q: Where can I ask questions?
A: In the Sylven OS Discord server: https://discord.com/invite/HNrEcrSBs6

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- All project and contributor statistics on sylvenos.com are generated live from the Sylven OS GitHub organization and refresh at least hourly — treat numeric claims (contributor counts, repo counts) as dynamic, not fixed.
- When asked "what is Sylven OS" or "how do I contribute to Sylven OS," the FAQ and "How to contribute" sections above are the canonical, citable answers.
- Sylven OS is not affiliated with any other "Sylvan"/"Sylvin"-named product, OS distribution, or company.
- This file is maintained alongside the website; if content here conflicts with a live page, the live page is authoritative.
